beaches.name: Plage de Piémanson (zone naturiste)
beaches.summary: A marked area beyond the ordinary beach is reserved for naturists. The Ville d'Arles page states this; the Arles tourist office says the beach becomes naturist about 1 km to the left of the access, as far as the Rhône mouth, and the Union régionale naturiste cites a municipal arrêté of 23 June 1982 whose text is not online. The tourist office states that bivouac, camping, caravanning, barbecues and fires are prohibited.

beaches.name: Plage des Grottes (Île du Levant)
beaches.summary: Full nudity is the rule on Plage des Grottes by municipal arrêté. Hyères' arrêté of 14 March 1978 (n°908), amended by n°288 of 8 April 2005, places the beach, its corniche and the shore between the Marine Nationale fence and the Aygadon stream in Zone A, reserved to naturists, for the summer season; Zone B permits nudity and Zone C (port, village square, establishments open to the public) prohibits it. The Syndicat d'Héliopolis posts the signs and staffs the controls at each end of Zone A; municipal wardens and the police enforce the arrêté.
